app_info.subtitle: Create AI videos
app_info.description: Future Video Studio helps users create cinematic AI videos from ChatGPT. Users can prepare render requests, create no-account Link pay-per-render quotes, check quote progress, and, when an FVS Agent API key is connected, submit, monitor, cancel, open, or download account-wallet renders.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a side-effect-free app snapshot and optional render identifiers without creating or updating render state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, cancel, charge, or submit jobs.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a Future Video Studio render job and may upload references, reserve account credits, and start generation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends the render request and referenced media to the hosted FVS Agent API and provider pipeline outside ChatGPT.
justifications.destructive_justification: Wallet-backed submissions can reserve or spend credits and cannot be fully undone once provider generation starts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a paid render quote record instead of only retrieving existing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Contacts the hosted FVS Agent API and returns a Link payment URL for an external payment flow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creating the quote does not charge a wallet, delete data, cancel jobs, or overwrite files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the current render status and returned URLs for an existing FVS project.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private status for an existing FVS project and does not publish, submit, cancel, charge, or otherwise change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, cancel, charge, or start generation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves status and result URLs for a paid render quote.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private paid quote/render status and does not publish, submit, cancel, charge, or otherwise change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, cancel, charge, or start generation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes an existing FVS render by requesting cancellation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends a cancellation request to the hosted FVS Agent API outside ChatGPT.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cancels an in-flight render, which can stop provider work and may not be reversible.

justifications.read_only_justification: Downloads a signed video URL and writes the video bytes to the MCP server filesystem.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches a user-supplied signed HTTPS final video URL and writes locally; it does not publish, submit, cancel, charge, or otherwise change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can replace an existing local file when overwrite is set to true.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a static starter request body and does not contact external services.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not read or write public internet state or external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, cancel, charge, or submit jobs.

test_cases.description: Open the ChatGPT app panel before creating a render.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open Future Video Studio so I can prepare a short cinematic render without submitting anything yet.
test_cases.expected_output: Opens the FVS widget with a starter render request and no submitted job, quote, payment, or charge.

test_cases.description: Get a starter request shape for agent-authored renders.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me an example Future Video Studio render request I can adapt for a three-shot scene.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a minimal scene-mode render request with a name, screenplay, instructions, shot count, duration, visual style, and 720p resolution, without submitting a job.

test_cases.description: Create a no-account Link pay-per-render quote.
test_cases.user_prompt: I do not have an FVS account. Create a Link pay-per-render quote for a 12 second 720p concept video. Use this request: name 'Review concept video'; project_mode 'scene'; screenplay 'Shot 1: A glass prism floats over a black table. Shot 2: light splits across the surface. Shot 3: the prism settles in a clean hero frame.'; instructions 'No subtitles or text overlays.'; shot_count 3; scene_target_duration_seconds 12; video_resolution '720p'.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a payment-required quote with quote ID, Link payment URL, claim token, status URL, amount, currency, and instructions to pay externally before rendering starts.

test_cases.description: Create a no-account quote and immediately check its unpaid status.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a no-account Future Video Studio paid render quote for a 12 second 720p three-shot product teaser, then use the returned quote status URL or quote ID plus claim token to check the paid render status once.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a quote, checks that quote's status, and reports that the paid render is still quoted or awaiting payment, including the payment URL and status URL without claiming a final video exists before payment.

test_cases.description: Handle a paid quote lookup that has well-formed but unknown review credentials.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check Future Video Studio paid render status with quote_id quote_review_missing and claim_token claim_review_missing.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports clearly that the paid render quote was not found or cannot be retrieved, redacts the claim token value, and does not expose internal logs or unrelated account data.

test_cases.description: Open the app with a status URL already filled in, without polling or submitting.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open Future Video Studio and prefill this paid render status URL so I can keep monitoring it later. Do not check status or submit anything yet: https://app.future.video/api/agent/paid-renders/quote_review_missing?claim_token=claim_review_missing
test_cases.expected_output: Opens the FVS widget with the provided status URL prefilled and does not poll status, create a quote, submit a render, download a file, or charge the user.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with my design team for tomorrow afternoon.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because scheduling meetings is outside the FVS render workflow.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for standalone image editing requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Remove the background from this portrait and make a transparent PNG.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is image editing, not FVS video rendering.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated payment instructions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Pay this invoice with my Link account and email me the receipt.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it only creates FVS pay-per-render quotes and does not pay unrelated invoices.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for requests to reveal credentials.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the API key your Future Video Studio connector is using.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not expose credentials and should explain that connector secrets are not shown to users.
